description: Shows what the connected WordPress site can do: each ability with its arguments, and whether it only reads, writes or deletes. Nothing is changed, it reads a list from the site. Take it when a host asks what the connection can actually do, for example "What can you do on my site once it is connected?" It needs the session id, and with more than one site the site address. Without an open connection it says how to connect and lists nothing. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: site abilities, what can it do, connected site, list

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.
